term: Smart speaker industry in South Korea
definition: Smart speakers, or AI speakers, have been developed by multiple domestic electronics and telecommunications firms in South Korea.
details: Since their introduction to the local market in 2016, they have been used by millions of people in the country.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. That shared ruler is Smart speaker industry in South Korea.
